subject: Urgent: same-day demo for BrightGrid — timezone coordination
messages:
From: Ophelia Green <ophelia.green@brightgrid.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-01T08:05:00+01:00
Subject: URGENT: Same-day demo request — board prep

Hi Kim,

Apologies for the last-minute ask. Our exec team moved a prep meeting to late today and they asked for a short 30–40 minute walkthrough of Redwood’s inference stack and cost controls. Ideally we’d like this before 19:00 CET (our APAC partners will dial in from SGT). Can you do something today at 18:30 CET / 01:30 SGT, or propose another late-evening slot?

We’re sensitive to DST — our calendar is showing CET but a couple of US stakeholders are on PDT now, so there may be an offset confusion. If you can’t do 18:30 CET, anything between 14:00–21:00 CET could work on our side.

We’ll need: short demo, Q&A with a technical engineer, and for the session to be recorded. Attaching an internal availability grid for our team.

Thanks,
Ophelia
Director, Platform Strategy
BrightGrid
[Attachment: bg-availability-apr01.csv]

- 16:00 CET — 23:00 SGT (less painful for APAC, but may conflict with EU folks)

Laura and Sergio — can one of you pick up the engineering Q&A if Aditya can’t join? If so, I’ll lock 18:30 CET and send an invite.

If you confirm 18:30 CET I’ll:
- send an invite with a recording link
- loop in Aditya for tech Q&A and add a short runbook for the session
- include a follow-up SOW snapshot for our procurement team

—Kim
